title: ochthochloa compressa
intro: Ochthochloa compressa, commonly known as Cenchris or Bur grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ochthochloa compressa include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, as well as its use in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
